proves.claim: With verify.reviewFolder on and the seat checkout at the submitted commit holding a modified tracked file and an untracked file, verify accept records the verdict from checks run in the review folder, leaving both seat files byte-identical.

cli.journeys-verify-review-folder-dirty..why: Without it, a dirty seat at the submitted commit keeps root on the seat and the verdict is refused DIRTY or UNTRACKED instead of being recorded from the clean review folder.
